desc: Derive the lazy segment-tree search and inclusive boundary conventions for each contest.
Prove that the current mapping remains monotone and that the affected initial-rating set is a contiguous interval.
Implement the \(O((N+Q)\log V)\) Python algorithm with fast input/output and required code delimiters.
Check edge cases: no affected ratings, duplicate mapped values, ratings below/above all intervals, overlapping contests, and values exceeding 500000.
